purpose: Wave F pre-registration: research universe, windows, opportunity classes, gates, maker-execution, shock (regime-switch) and FORWARD-seal protocols, hypothesis pipeline, operating rules and execution order
pre_registration: docs/ROADMAP.md section 7 and its section-6 entry of 2026-10-15; the ROADMAP text prevails, a difference is a defect fixed in this file and logged in ROADMAP section 6

state_at_registration.measured_while_writing: top-40 member and member-month counts only (no performance numbers)

TRAIN-F.use: exploration and TRAIN gates of every class; class researchers see only this

TRAIN-B.use: pairs_neutral and regime_switch: TRAIN gate on the chosen configurations only (<= 2, regime_switch 1)

VALID-F.use: one confirmation per candidate, only for code that never saw 2026; run by the gatekeeper

FORWARD.use: 30-day sealed blocks (forward_seal) confirming code that saw 2026

code_saw_2026.definition: the alpha/strategy module (or a module it inherits parameters from) was evaluated by lab, backtest, research cycle, replay or discover on a window overlapping 2026-01-01..2026-10-06, or its design/parameters were chosen from 2026 results; shared infrastructure (engine, backtester) does not count
code_saw_2026.registered_alphas: all 16 (discovered included): the 9 originals were designed on 2026, the 4 P2 candidates were VALID-run on 2026, xs_rank_mom / funding_carry_xs / discovered could be evaluated by 2026 replay research cycles
code_saw_2026.llm_proposals: treated as having seen 2026 (the model's training data may cover 2026 markets)
code_saw_2026.residual_contamination: researchers know the P2 VALID (2026) results; recorded as a limitation

research_universe.rule: per month m: top 40 USDT perpetuals by the median daily quote volume of month m-1 (stablecoins excluded, listed >= 30 days at the start of m, a relisting counts from its new first trade), delisted symbols included (--universe top40, docs/UNIVERSE.md section 3)
research_universe.point_in_time: only entries in months the symbol was a member count (universe.member_trades); a position held when membership lapses follows its exit rules
research_universe.delisting: forced close at the symbol's last traded hour at that hour's close, slippage 5x nominal (stress 10x); entries are not blocked in advance (announcement dates are not in the data; blocking would use future information)
research_universe.fixed_lists: no gate is judged on core 12 / extended 20 as the universe; those symbols are used like any other in their member months, and the fixed list itself serves evaluator equivalence checks only

costs.funding: charged only to positions open at the settlement time s (entered before s, closed after s), on the stored settlement schedule of each symbol (1, 2, 4 and 8 hour intervals occur)
costs.time_convention: 'the close at t' is the last instant (t - 1 ms) of the 1h bar [t - 1h, t): a position closed at the close at s neither pays nor receives the s settlement, and the s rate is usable from the close at s + 1h
costs.fills: decisions use information up to the bar close; market fills at the far side of the synthetic book built from that close plus slippage (as the lab's PaperAccount)

statistics.directional: R units; avg_r, PF, t_day = day-clustered t of trades grouped by UTC exit day (lab.group_stats); years by entry time
statistics.neutral: percent of capital C; daily net PnL marking both legs at each UTC day end (zero days included); gating t = Newey-West HAC t of the daily net PnL (Bartlett kernel, fixed lag 14 days; amended 2026-10-16), plain daily t informational; annualized net return = daily mean x 365; max drawdown on the daily equity curve; calendar years and quarters; weekly-block t kept for information (daily carry PnL is autocorrelated)

hourly_directional.data: universe.db 1h klines + funding, OI 1h and premium index 1h (F-data-h)
hourly_directional.exits: stop, target, time exit only (no breakeven, no trailing); stop first when stop and target fall in the same hour

two_leg_neutral.module: F-pre-A shared frame, class rules by the class researcher

evaluators.decision_equivalence_before_confirmation: a 1h-class candidate is ported to an engine alpha module whose decisions (hour, side) match the evaluator on >= 99% over TRAIN on the 20 long-history symbols

ledger_and_procedure.ledger: docs/results/p2_trials.jsonl (one append-only ledger for all waves)
ledger_and_procedure.recording: every evaluator records each evaluated configuration itself (lab/discover --tag, hourly/neutral evaluators as 'screen' lines)
ledger_and_procedure.n: distinct configurations of the family (discovery: rules searched); maker_exec adds the source family's N
ledger_and_procedure.config_hash: must include the execution mode 'exec' (F-pre-A); stress, VALID and FORWARD reruns of a configuration do not grow N
ledger_and_procedure.researchers: see TRAIN only; do not read VALID/FORWARD result files or confirmation sections before their candidates are frozen; an unrecorded evaluation is a protocol violation
ledger_and_procedure.gatekeeper: separate agent: recomputes TRAIN gates from result files, audits look-ahead (decisions on views cut at the decision bar vs full views, as tests/test_p2_gate.py), runs each confirmation once

train_neutral.annualized_net_return_note: after all fees and slippage: the draft's 'costs + 2%' (gross must beat costs by 2 points a year)

forward_neutral.over: the registered span (3 blocks, one quarter)

gates.stress_in_confirmation: reported, not gating (as the P2 VALID gate)
gates.power_note: a zero-edge candidate passes a confirmation with probability about 0.16 (t >= 1.0 one-sided); the TRAIN gate carries the overfitting control
gates.on_pass_directional: enabled_by_default=True (maker_exec: the execution mode becomes the shipped default too); evidence.json verdict 'passed' with TRAIN and confirmation numbers, execution mode and source document; kill-switch expected R = min(TRAIN avg_r, confirmation avg_r); live only after graduation + /golive
gates.on_pass_neutral: the strategy engine runs in paper by default; evidence.json strategy entry (kind 'neutral') verdict 'passed'; kill switch = CUSUM of daily net return in TRAIN daily-sd units (k 0.25, h 8, expectation min(TRAIN, confirmation) daily mean) or trailing 30-day net < -1% of strategy capital; live only after graduation + /golive (carry also needs the key's spot trading and universal transfer permissions, auto-detected)
gates.on_pass_regime_switch: the per-regime enable table ships on (ensemble per-regime bandit weights 0/1)
gates.on_pass_ai_hypothesis: never shipped automatically: paper challenger only (failed-alpha checkpoints 30/60/90 days), one Telegram notice with an approval button; without the owner's approval it stays a challenger (no champion promotion, no shipped default, no live)
gates.on_fail: stays off / not shipped; a candidate that reached its confirmation gets evidence verdict 'failed'; configurations stopped at TRAIN stay in the ledger and docs/RESEARCH_F.md only; the same config hash is never confirmed again; a modified variant is a new configuration (TRAIN gate with the grown N, then a confirmation within the family's candidate cap)

carry_neutral.source: spot long + perp short collecting funding (delta neutral); no price forecast; the reverse leg (perp long + spot short) needs spot borrowing and is not traded
carry_neutral.universe: top-40 members of month m that have a spot USDT market passing the pairing check point in time (median |basis| < 5% over the hours of month m-1 both markets traded, symbols_inventory.paired_as_of; amended 2026-10-16, the whole-history check of docs/results/f0_spot_coverage.json is a data report) and a prior-month median daily spot quote volume >= 5,000,000 USDT
carry_neutral.decision: for each settlement time s of the symbol, at the first close after it (the close at s + 1h), the s rate known; inputs: settled funding up to s, basis at the decision, both markets' 1h history; no predicted funding (not in the archive)
carry_neutral.rule: enter when the annualized mean of the last k settled rates (by the symbol's interval) >= A_in and basis >= -0.5% (no entry when the perp trades more than 0.5% below spot: a basis returning to 0 loses); exit when it is <= A_out; more candidates than slots: highest annualized value first; at most 8 positions
carry_neutral.sizing: capital C = spot wallet + futures wallet; each leg notional 0.075 C per symbol (0.6 C / 8); perp isolated 2x (margin = notional / 2), maintenance margin rate fixed at 1.5%; rebalance when the perp close >= 130% of entry (sell spot and cut the perp by the same fraction to restore margin = notional / 2, costs included); a 1h high reaching the liquidation price before the rebalance counts as a forced liquidation losing the whole margin
carry_neutral.on_pass: build the live carry engine (spot orders, wallet transfers, two-leg reconcile), run it in paper by default; live needs the key's spot trading + universal transfer permissions (auto-detected at start; otherwise one line in the start message) + graduation + /golive; leverage <= 2

maker_exec.source: the 15 registered alphas (discovered excluded) re-evaluated with maker execution
maker_exec.params: shipped defaults, vol_breakout_dbox with its judged comp_q=1.0; no re-tuning in this class
maker_exec.data: 1m candles, funding, 5m metrics of top-40 member months (F-data-1m)
maker_exec.n_for_gate: N(maker_exec) + N of the alpha's P2 family: ts_trend 27, positioning_flow 21, vol_breakout 23, discovery_daily 105068, xs_rank 20, funding_carry 7; the 9 P1 alphas add 0
maker_exec.data_condition: F-data-1m; if the disk is short, rolling-year mode (download one year of 1m, run all 30 configurations nominal + stress, store the trade lists, delete, next year); possible because the grid is fixed
maker_exec.on_pass: the alpha runs with maker execution; ORDERBOOK_STREAM on while it is enabled, post-only at the best quote

pairs_neutral.source: mean reversion of the spread of two perpetuals tied to the same factor; market exposure hedged by the two legs
pairs_neutral.universe: pairs of two top-40 members of month m
pairs_neutral.formation: at each month start, data before m only: pairs with 90 days of 1h closes; rho = correlation of 1h log returns, beta = OLS slope of log prices clipped to [0.5, 2], spread = log p1 - beta log p2, AR(1) half-life; keep rho >= rho_min and half-life 6..168 h, top K by rho, a symbol in at most 2 pairs
pairs_neutral.trading: beta fixed in month m; z = (spread - mean of prior 720 h) / sd of prior 720 h; enter |z| >= z_in (high spread: short p1, long p2), exit |z| <= 0.5, stop |z| >= z_in + 1.5, exit after max hold H; at most 5 open pairs
pairs_neutral.sizing: first leg 0.1 C, second leg 0.1 C x beta, each leg isolated 2x; perp costs on both legs, funding on both legs
pairs_neutral.procedure: evaluate the whole grid on TRAIN-A (first formation 2022-03-01 when 90 days of history exist); evaluate at most the 2 configurations with the highest TRAIN-A t on TRAIN-B; the gate is judged on TRAIN-B; N counts A and B

liq_cascade.source: overshoot after forced-liquidation cascades and its partial reversal over the following hours
liq_cascade.data: universe.db 1h OHLC, quote volume, taker-buy share; OI 1h (F-data-h) for proxy B
liq_cascade.event_long: at hour close T: r_1h <= -k x sd of 1h log returns over the prior 720 h; quote volume >= v x median 1h quote volume over the prior 720 h; taker-buy share <= 0.40; proxy B also: OI change over the hour <= -x%
liq_cascade.trade: enter at the T close; stop = event bar low - 0.5 x 1h ATR(14) (mirror for shorts); no target; unconditional exit after h hours (time_exit); skip when the stop distance > 10%; one position per symbol

grid.proxy_B: x in {2%, 4%} on the 4 proxy-A configurations with the highest TRAIN t_day (<= 8)

liq_cascade.force_order_stream: collected only (F5); after >= 6 blocks a new TRAIN on it is pre-registered; Wave F candidates of this class use the proxy only

event_funding.source: price pressure around funding settlements (the paying side cuts before s and re-opens after)
event_funding.data: universe.db 1h, settled funding; premium index 1h (F-data-h) for E1
event_funding.settlements: s from the stored settlement records; rates normalized to 8 h (f x 8 / interval hours)
event_funding.E1: at the close at s - j h (j in {1, 2}): if |f_hat| >= f_min enter against the paying side (f_hat > 0: short); exit at the close at s (just before the settlement, no funding exchanged); f_hat = P + clamp(0.01% - P, -0.05%, +0.05%), P = mean 1h premium index over the current settlement interval
event_funding.E2: at the close at s + 1h: if |f_s| >= f_min enter in the paying side's direction (f_s > 0: long); exit at the close at s + 1h + h (h in {3, 6}), never past the close at the next settlement

grid.order: E2 first until the premium index data exists; 1m variants only after F-data-1m, same family N

regime_switch.start_condition: >= 2 directional Wave F candidates passed their TRAIN gate; otherwise recorded as 'no components' and skipped

regimes.volatility: BTC 30-day realized vol in the low / mid / high tercile of its prior 365 days
regimes.trend: BTC daily close above / below its 50-day EMA

regime_switch.enable_table: per component: off in regime r if its TRAIN-A trades in r (regime at entry) number >= n_min with avg_r <= 0; on otherwise
regime_switch.evaluation: filter the components' TRAIN-B trade lists by regime at entry and the enable table (independent per-symbol accounts, as the lab)

confirmation.how: filter the components' confirmation trade lists of the same blocks

discovery_f.source: rule discovery on a versioned, expanded feature set
discovery_f.feature_set: existing features (vwap_z first-bar fix of F-pre-B included) + historical F5 features (basis z, premium index, proxy liquidation events, time to the next settlement); live-only features (book imbalance, forceOrder) only after >= 6 blocks are collected
discovery_f.cadence: one discovery run per feature-set version, at most one version a month
discovery_f.candidates: at most 2 self-validated rules per version, ported to standalone alpha files, lab TRAIN gate on TRAIN-F

confirmation.exception: FORWARD when the rule matches a P2 VALID-tested rule (same features and direction, thresholds within +-10%)

ai_hypothesis.active: only when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set (the owner supplies Binance keys only, so off by default)
ai_hypothesis.cadence: at most one proposal a week, at most 4 configurations per proposal; family N sums all proposals
ai_hypothesis.inputs: these rules, the alpha interface, ledger summary, per-class TRAIN summaries; never VALID or FORWARD results
ai_hypothesis.sandbox: code under <data dir>/proposals/; separate process, no network, no file writes, allow-listed imports (math, numpy, heartless.strategy.base, heartless.data.features ...), CPU 30 min, memory 1.5 GB
ai_hypothesis.frames: decisions of 1h or longer while 1m member data is missing
pipeline: invariants: symbol rename, prices x1000 / x0.001 / x1024, same decisions on views cut at the decision bar
TRAIN gate (evaluator matching the decision frame)
ai_hypothesis.not_counted: proposals failing the invariants were never evaluated on data: not in N, kept in a separate log
ai_hypothesis.owner_line: never beyond a paper challenger without the owner's approval button; the bot does not ask questions

maker_execution.setting: engine params['exec'][alpha] in {taker (default), maker_m1, maker_m2}; not an alpha ParamSpec (that would change every parameter-schema fingerprint and make all evidence entries 'untested'); part of the trial config hash
maker_execution.maker_m1: market signals become a post-only limit at the decision bar close; cancel after 1 decision bar (max 60 min); no re-quote, no market fallback
maker_execution.maker_m2: retest limit at close -/+ 0.25 x signal ATR (long below, short above); cancel after 3 decision bars (max 240 min); drop the signal when the limit is beyond the stop
maker_execution.limit_signals: alphas that already emit a limit keep their limit price; only the validity rule above applies (no re-quote)
maker_execution.sizing: quantity recomputed from the limit price and the stop (0.5% risk per trade, P0b rule)

fill_model.trade_through: a resting buy fills only when the 1m low trades below the limit by at least half the synthetic spread (sell mirrored); a touch does not fill (PaperAccount rule)
fill_model.volume: no fill in a 1m bar whose quote volume < 20 x the order notional
fill_model.price_fee: fill at the limit, maker fee 2 bp, no slippage; exits (stops etc.) stay taker
fill_model.stress: trade-through by the full synthetic spread, fees x1.5, taker slippage x2

maker_execution.gates: the same directional gates (TRAIN-F, then FORWARD)

shock_protocol.code: heartless/strategy/shock.py, the same code in backtest, lab, replay and live (F-pre-B); offline = online equivalence test
shock_protocol.fixed: definitions are fixed and never tuned on performance

detection.S0: BTC 5-minute move >= 3% -> 15 minutes without new entries (existing live rule, added to the backtester); every minute
detection.S1: |BTC 1h log return| >= 4 x sd of the prior 720 hourly returns; hourly
detection.S2: BTC 24h realized vol (sqrt of the sum of squared 1h returns) >= 2.5 x median of the same statistic over the prior 30 days; hourly
detection.S3: mean 24h correlation of 1h returns with BTC over the 40 eligible USDT perpetuals trading at that hour with the highest prior-24h quote volume, point in time from universe.db (amended 2026-10-16; not the union of window members) >= 0.80 and >= its prior 30-day mean + 0.25; hourly

shock_protocol.shock_state: starts at the hour close where any of S1-S3 fires; ends after 24 h without a firing

responses.entry_halt: for 2 hours from the hour close of an S1-S3 firing no new entries (every decision frame), resting entry limits cancelled; open positions keep their stops, targets and time limits; shock_exempt alphas (liq_cascade) excluded; on by default
responses.regime_table: the shock-regime enable table, only when a regime_switch candidate passed
responses.kill_switch: CUSUM alarm h 8 -> 6 for 30 days after the latest firing (k and the 30-trade sum unchanged); on by default
responses.revalidation_window: research cycle window 120 -> 45 days from the start of a shock state until 45 days after the last firing; research proposal rules and challenger checkpoints/thresholds unchanged

shock_protocol.reporting: after F-pre-B, lab results include the entry halt and S0; F-pre-B reports only the number of shock hours and blocked decisions in TRAIN-F (no performance numbers)

forward_seal.rule: FWD-k starts at origin + 30 (k-1) days, end exclusive
forward_seal.sealed_scope: sealed from its start until opened (seal.py schedule, F4); lab, discover, backtest --start/--end, replay, hourly/neutral evaluators and screening scripts refuse overlapping windows; the live bot's automated loops (research cycle, discovery, challengers, kill switch) keep running on the operations DB because they make no pre-registered decision and their results are never used for confirmations

registration.deadline: registered_utc before the start of the span's first block
registration.how: the gatekeeper registers after its audit with 'heartless forward register'; the bot's automated path (F3b) calls the same code; target = the earliest block starting >= 24 h later

span.directional: smallest number of blocks (1-3) whose expected trades (TRAIN trades per 30 days) >= 100, else 3

forward_seal.opening: after the block ends and its data is complete (all needed member 1m or 1h bars and every funding settlement, from the archive including universe build month/day files, or the bot's stored records): 'heartless forward confirm FWD-k' runs every registration ending at that block once (nominal + stress), writes docs/results/fwd_<block>_<candidate>.json, appends one seal-ledger line (docs/results/seal_ledger.jsonl) listing the runs, and moves the block to SPENT; a block without registrations is opened empty the same way
forward_seal.multi_block: earlier blocks open on schedule, but the span's candidate is evaluated once when its last block opens; a config hash with an open registration cannot be evaluated on windows overlapping its span (F4 refuses)
forward_seal.reruns: only a run that produced no result, with the reason in the registration ledger
forward_seal.fwd_01: started before this registration: nothing can be registered on it; it opens empty when complete; the first registrable block is FWD-02 (2026-11-06)
forward_seal.spent_blocks: ordinary history; TRAIN-F is not extended (that needs a new registration)

operating_rules.universe: live universe = universe.live_selection (USDT perpetual, TRADING, no stablecoins, listed 30 days, 24h quote volume, tick <= 10 bp, book spread <= 5 bp) top UNIVERSE_SIZE, re-selected hourly; no hard-coded coins
operating_rules.always_include: BTCUSDT by default, a data subscription for the regime/context reference, not a trading guarantee; separated from the traded list in the F6 rewiring

context.research: stores built with top_n = 40 point in time: every eligible USDT perpetual trading at that hour (universe.db 1h blocks), ranked by prior-24h quote volume (amended 2026-10-16; previously the union of window members, which depended on future membership)
context.live: F6 rewiring sets CONTEXT_TOP_N = 40 over every perpetual passing the live exchange filters; the fixed 20-symbol CONTEXT_UNIVERSE is retired

operating_rules.invariants: alpha/strategy code never reads symbol names; a new alpha must pass the invariant tests (rename, price multiples) and the cut-at-decision test before its ledger record

latency_budget.breach: p99 over target 3 days in a row is flagged in the daily report; no automatic setting change

operating_rules.orderbook_stream: on while an enabled alpha reads ctx.book or trades with maker execution
operating_rules.book_guard: skip an entry when the spread >= 3 x its own prior-24h median and >= 5 bp, or depth within +-10 bp < 25% of its own prior-24h median, or (amended 2026-10-16) while ORDERBOOK_STREAM is on the book is missing, unsynced, older than 3 s, NaN or does not reach +-10 bp (orderbook.usable_book false); history uses the conservative bar_book_proxy (relative thresholds keep the meaning); same rule in backtest and live (F-pre-B)
operating_rules.data_budget: new data hourly by default in universe.db; 1m only for member months (+ warm-up) of 1m-decision classes

prerequisites.content: member-window filtering in lab and discover; lab context top_n; ledger period labels TRAIN-F/A/B, VALID-F, FWD-k and 'exec' in the config hash; hourly and neutral evaluators (self-recording, delisting close, daily equity)
prerequisites.acceptance: tests; evaluator equivalence with a deterministic non-signal reference alpha (long at every 24th hour close, 2 ATR stop, 12 h exit) on the 20 long-history symbols in 2024: >= 99% of trades matched with the lab, mean absolute per-trade R difference <= 0.02 R

prerequisites.content: shock layer, execution modes, Context.book field and backtester proxy wiring, book guard, vwap_z first-bar fix, backtester delisting close, maker fill extras (next bar, 20x volume)
prerequisites.acceptance: tests; with exec taker, shock layer off and book guard off the existing lab trade list is byte-identical (the F7 htf_trend hash); only counts of trades changed by the shock layer and the guard are reported
tests: sealed refusal, registration deadline, run-once, empty opening, live-loop exemption

prerequisites.content: F0 leftovers (live selection, reference symbols data-only, CONTEXT_TOP_N), F7 leftovers (uvloop, daily-report latency line), shock layer in the app (replacing _btc_shock_check), 24/7 docker-compose, restart-recovery replay test, weekly report (per-alpha evidence, challenger checkpoints, kill switch, shocks); F5: hourly per-symbol forceOrder aggregates and hourly book summaries stored
prerequisites.acceptance: full test suite; 3-day integration replay with 0 violations

prerequisites.content: OI 1h (from the 5m metrics archive) and premium index 1h for top-40 member months into universe.db, <= 250 MB
prerequisites.acceptance: row counts; hourly values equal the long-history 5m OI on the 20 symbols

prerequisites.content: 1m candles of member months for 1m-decision classes: TRAIN-F 206 symbols / 1,130 symbol-months and VALID-F 89 / 223 not in the long-history DB; with 1-3 months of warm-up TRAIN-F 1,488-1,949 symbol-months (about 6.1 MB each, about 9-12 GB) and VALID-F 320-485 (about 2-3 GB, needed only for discovery_f confirmations)
prerequisites.acceptance: free disk >= estimate + 3 GB before downloading; otherwise maker_exec in rolling-year mode (about 2.5-3.5 GB a year); otherwise recorded as blocked_data and no substitute universe is used
prerequisites.coverage_rule: amended 2026-10-16: a topN lab / discover run is refused (blocked_data) when more than 2% of its member-months (clipped to the window and the last traded hour; covered with >= 90% of their minutes stored) or of its membership spans' 12-day 1m warm-ups are missing; --allow-partial runs are never recorded in the trial ledger and never part of a FORWARD command

parallel: F-pre-B engine, shock layer, maker modes
gatekeeper: TRAIN recomputation and audit, VALID once each, FORWARD registrations
F-data-1m (disk condition) then maker_exec then discovery_f
F3b AI pipeline implementation (runs only with a key)
FORWARD confirmation session per block (F4 tool), decisions applied by the gatekeeper

order_rationale: maker re-evaluation needs about 9-12 GB of 1m data with 1-2 GB free, so the 1h classes whose data exists go first; the FORWARD seal must exist before any FORWARD-bound candidate; deployment starts early because live data takes time to accumulate
concurrency: at most 2 agents at once; the two tasks of a wave own disjoint files; full tests, review and commit at the end of each wave

class_researcher: candidates ported to alpha/strategy modules, committed disabled by default
gatekeeper: Wave F rows in ROADMAP section 5

decision_principles: no class passes: the bot keeps researching, discovering and running challengers in paper; an acceptable outcome
leverage: carry/neutral <= 2x; directional alphas keep the existing risk budget (0.5% per trade)
spot permission auto-detected: present -> a passed carry becomes a live candidate; absent -> carry stays paper with one line in the start message
short of disk or data: the class waits; no substitute universe or shorter window
will_not_do: register after seeing a sealed block
judge a gate on a fixed symbol list

what: neutral gating t -> Newey-West HAC t, lag 14 days
research context and S3 cross-section point in time
parallelism beyond 2 agents with disjoint worktrees
topN lab/discover refuse a partial member set (> 2% of member-months or warm-ups without 1m data): blocked_data
book_guard also skips entries while the stream book is missing, unsynced, stale (> 3 s), NaN or short of +-10 bp
carry_neutral spot pairing check point in time (month m-1)
amendments.seen: no Wave F hypothesis result; only member-month / warm-up counts, context candidate counts, timing, memory and a lab trade-list hash
